verses.text: yal laahu bil mustafas sindiidi yal laahu
wa bi khaliilika ibraahiima yal laahu
wa bi kaliimika muusaa saalihin khadirin
wa bi shuhaybin wa ismaahiila yal laahu
wa bi sulaymaana nuuhin yuunusal yasahi
wa zakariyyaa-a yahyaa huuda yal laahu
haruuna yuushuha ilyaasin wa aadama daa
wuuda wa zil kifli hiisaa luuta yal laahu
wa yuusufin wa bi is-haaqin wa ghayrihimu
minan biyaa-in wa ruslin laka yal laahu
wa bil malaa-iki turran summa safwatihim
jibriila summa bimiikaa-iila yal laahu
wa saahibin nafkhi israafiila qaabidi ar
waahil khalaa-iqi  hazraa-iila yal laahu
wa bis sahaabati summal awliyaa-i mahan
wal haamiliina minal ahbaari yal laahu
wa bis siddiiqi wa bil faaruuqi summa bizin
nuurayni summa abis sibtayni yal laahu
bi maalikin zil mazaayash shaafihiyyi abii
haniifatin ahmadal mahmuudi yal laahu
bil lawhi wal qalamil mahfuuzi summa bihar
shikal haziimi wa bil kursiyyi yal laahu
wa bil qur-aani wa bit tawriiti summa bimaa
daawudu jaa-a bihi war ruuhu yal laahu
balligh salaati wa tasliimii halayhi lahu
wal aali was sahbi wal azwaaji yal laahu
wa asbilanna halaynaa rabbi haafiyatan
wa hab lanal qasda fid daarayni yal laahu
waftah lanaa kulla baabin kunta faatihahu
lis saalihiina minal khayraati yal laahu
wasluk binaa nahja rushdin wakfinaa zalalan
watrud lanal jinna wash shaytaana yal laahu
wa kammilan kullamaa nanhuu wa naqsuduhu
wa hab lanaa kullamaa nakhtaaru yal laahu
wa rud lanaa kulla zii sahbin wa zii haranin
wa yassiran kulla zit tahsiiri yal laahu
tawwil lanaa humranaa sahhih lanaa badanan
wa hab lanar rushda wat tawfiiqa yal laahu
wa dammiran kulla ahdaa-in tudirru binaa
qablal wusuuli lanaa yal laahu yal laahu
wa kun lanaa haasiman min kulli mahlakatin
wa najjinaa min balaa yad dahra yal laahu
wa aafatin haahatin mah ghussatin mihanin
zalzalatin shiddatin wal faqri yal laahu
ihaanatin qillatin mah zillatin ghalabin
wa faaqatin hatashin wal juuhi yal laahu
wa fitnatin wal wabaa wal harqi mah gharaqin
wal barqi mah saraqin wal kaddi yal laahu
harrin wa bardin wa nahbin kurbatin niqamin
dalaalatin harajin wal ghammi yal laahu
wa haammatin wa khataa yaa daallatin zalalin
wal maskhi wal khasfi summal qazfi yal laahu
wa ghullatin mah junuunin hillatin maradin
summal juzaamayni wan nuqsaani yal laahu
wa min qabiihati dunyaa summa aakhiratin
wa min fuduuhihimaa yal laahu yal laahu
yaa man halaa kulli shay-in qaadirun wa halal
harshil haziimis tawaa bil qahri yal laahu
innii sa-altuka qalban khashihan mutawaa
dihan wa hilman kasiiran nafhi yal laahu
wa tawbaatan qubilat mah miknatin rufihat
mah zawjatin salluhat bid diini yal laahu
wa kun muhiizan lanaa min sharri zii hasadin
mah sharri fammin wa sharril hayni yal laahu
wa sharri sihrin wa sharril khalqi insihimu
mah jinnihim wa zawaatis sumi yal laahu
innii jahaltuka fid daarayni yaa siqatii
hisnan hasinan fakun maljaaya yal laahu
falaatakilnii ilaa nafsii fa-ahlika kun
mujiibanii haysumaa adhuuka yal laahu
wajhal lisaanii wa qalbii zaakirayka mahan
hindal mamaati mahal iimaani yal laahu
sabbit yaqiiniya fii qalbii bilaa wajalin
hattaa uhibba liqaakal haqqa yal laahu
wa lij halil mawta raahaatin wa mafrahatan
min kulli sharrin wa karbin daaqa yal laahu
wahfaz liyal jisma haysur ruuhu faaraqanii
fil qabri laa tubliyanhud dahra yal laahu
wa kun nasiiri aniisii hiinamaa dafanuu
jismii fasirtu wa hiidaan samma yal laahu
laa tadmumanna mahii maa qad yurawwi hunii
balik fiyan kullamaa akhshaahu yal laahu
wa najjiinii wa jamiihal musliimiina mahan
wa najji waalidatii aamina yal laahu
waghfir lanaa wa lahaa wastur mahaa ibanaa
waltuf binaa wa bihaa fil hawli yal laahu
hanha tajaawaz wa iyyaanar hamanna famaa
lanaa siwaaka wa antal barru yal laahu
fii barzakhin maha qabrin kun lahaa wazaran
wa min kuruubin wa khawfin najji yal laahu
laa takhtabirhaa bimaa laysat biqaadiratin
walaa tukhayyib rajaahaa fiika yal laahu
wa asqiina mahahaa min maa-i kawsari man
ikhtartahu min jamiihil khalqi yal laahu
man kaana yurshidu zaa ghayyin wa yuhliku zaa
kufrin wa yansuru man yakhshaaka yal laahu
muhammadin mazkaa-il akhyaari qaa-idinaa
lijannatil khuldi yawmal hashri yal laahu
halayhi salli wa sallim daa-iman abadan
wa man khafawhu liyawmid diini yal laahu
